name: Knock On The Occult Door
source: Welcome to your new practice, where the broken, damned, and dangerous arrive by appointment. In Knock on the Occult Door you play a ritual specialist and spiritual confidant, weighing grief, rage, and regret as you choose to bind in vengeance, release in peace, or trap a client in their own darkness. Your accessories, intuition, and restraint shape branching rituals that can bind, trap, release, or destroy; occult tools alter what you perceive and say, but instincts matter more. You don’t give advice, you perform bindings and some clients will manipulate you, others may try to kill you; consequences are permanent, and death is possible. This is a story-driven gothic visual novel of haunting performances, layered choices, and costly sigils where every soul has a story and every binding leaves a mark. Are you ready to open the door? https://store.steampowered.com/app/3821420/Knock_On_The_Occult_Door/
translation: 欢迎来到你的新诊所，破碎的、该死的和危险的人会按预约到达。在《敲开神秘之门》中，你扮演一名仪式专家和精神知己，权衡悲伤、愤怒和悔恨，选择以复仇的方式捆绑、以和平的方式释放，或将客户困在自己的黑暗中。你的配件、直觉和克制塑造了可以束缚、困住、释放或破坏的分支仪式；神秘工具会改变你的感知和言论，但本能更重要。你不提供建议，你执行绑定，一些客户会操纵你，另一些客户可能会试图杀死你；后果是永久性的，甚至可能死亡。这是一部故事驱动的哥特式视觉小说，其中有令人难忘的表演、分层的选择和昂贵的印记，每个灵魂都有一个故事，每个装订都会留下印记。你准备好开门了吗？https://store.steampowered.com/app/3821420/Knock_On_The_Occult_Door/
